findings.title: src/dopemux_pr_merge_specialist/steward_gate.py [1]
findings.body:
Canonical provenance validation is executed only when the proof's embedded_audit.status is exactly "SKIPPED". For the strict-PASS pair, control flows: `if not finalization_audit_evidence_allowed(evidence): deny` -> (status != SKIPPED) -> TTL -> `ALLOW_FINALIZATION`. `_evidence()` extracts only readiness/proof statuses, `required`, `skip_reason`, `generated_at` and the three head SHAs; it never reads `executed`, `dry_run`, `repo`, `pr_number` or `provenance`. Therefore a locally-present PROOF.json whose `embedded_audit.status == "PASS"` is accepted with (a) `executed: false`, (b) `dry_run: true`, (c) a foreign `repo`/`pr_number`, or (d) forged/absent `provenance`, provided only that `head_sha` matches the caller head and the timestamps are fresh. Note that fork commits share SHAs with upstream, so head-SHA equality is not repo-disambiguating. The newly added identity arguments (`expected_repo`/`expected_pr`/`expected_base_sha`) are mandatory for PASS calls (DENY_MISSING_CALLER_IDENTITY) but are then unused on that path. Consequence: the NOT_REQUIRED hardening delivered by this packet is asymmetric — an actor able to write the policy-path artifacts (the same capability required to forge NOT_REQUIRED evidence) can instead assert `PASS` and bypass every new check.
Auditor disposition: PRE_EXISTING_RESIDUAL_RISK_NOT_INTRODUCED_BY_THIS_CHANGE. The diff does not alter the PASS branch, and task-packet invariant 'preserve ordinary executed PASS and PASS_WITH_RISKS semantics' plus docs/ops/steward-merge-gate.md ('executed-audit proof semantics ... are unchanged') explicitly scope it out. NON-BLOCKING for this packet; recorded as the primary remaining risk. Follow-on packet should extend independent_audit_errors coverage to the PASS branch (at minimum executed/dry_run/repo/pr_number/provenance-author/workflow).

findings.title: src/dopemux_pr_merge_specialist/steward_gate.py, tools/pr_steward/collector.py, pyproject.toml [2]
findings.body:
The canonical validator lives in `scripts/audit/run_embedded_audit.py`. The explicit `packages` list in pyproject.toml enumerates `dopemux.*`, `dopemux_pr_*`, `tools`, `tools.pr_steward`, `conport`, `core`, `integrations`, `utils` — it does not contain `scripts` or `scripts.audit`. All four mirrored steward_gate.py copies (src, templates, .claude/skills, .github/skills) therefore reach the validator only from a repository checkout. In an installed/packaged deployment the FINALIZATION NOT_REQUIRED path returns `DENY_AUDIT_VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE` (correct fail-closed behaviour, exercised by test_finalization_gate.py::test_finalization_canonical_validator_unavailable_fails_closed_only_for_not_required), while the unvalidated PASS path continues to function — an availability asymmetry that biases operators toward the weaker evidence class. Separately, `collector._independent_audit_errors` performs the same import with no try/except despite its comment 'Local import keeps collector importable when scripts/ is unavailable'; an ImportError there propagates out of `_proof_state` rather than degrading to NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.
Auditor disposition: PRE_EXISTING_PACKAGING/AVAILABILITY_RISK. Not introduced by this diff (the imports and the packages list predate it; this packet only adds `dopemux.dcp` and a kwarg). NON-BLOCKING: both failure modes are deny/raise, not allow. Recommend a follow-on packet either package the canonical validator or guard the collector import.

findings.title: proof/TP-DMX-CI-AUDIT-EVIDENCE-GATE-001-A5-R3-PROVENANCE-CLOSURE-001/PROOF.json [3]
findings.body:
No supplied artifact binds the audited frozen head a54eb4ab151ba1d4c015648c9f111868b6d1fbf2 to the validated content. PROOF.json records `start_head_sha: 13562c8d...`, `head_sha: null`, `independent_audit_status: NOT_RUN`; P2_FINAL_VALIDATION.json and P2_INTEGRATION_ALIGNMENT.json record only the start head; BASELINE_STOP.json / P2_SCOPE_STOP.json record `final_substantive_head: null` (correctly, as preserved history). The 'post-commit freeze receipt' referenced by status_scope is not among the 44 supplied files. Consequently the closeout criterion in docs/ops/pr-acceptance.md ('proof is current to the PR head SHA') is not evidenced for a54eb4ab, and `change_contract_preflight` in P2_FINAL_VALIDATION.json explicitly states 'rerun on frozen HEAD required'.
Auditor disposition: DOCUMENTATION/CLOSEOUT_GAP, NON-BLOCKING FOR CODE CORRECTNESS. Mitigated because this packet PROOF.json is not the artifact consumed by the gates (PR Steward reads the CI `independent-audit/PROOF.json` via `--proof-path`, and the merge specialist reads the configured `steward_gate.*_path` artifacts), and because the file itself asserts merge/ready/export/activation are all unauthorized. A supervisor must record the freeze receipt binding a54eb4ab before any readiness or merge claim.
Supervisor deterministic closure: existing S3_FROZEN_CONTENT.json records the exact audited head/tree and post-freeze L3 change-contract check; this proof now pins that same head. Raw finding remains unchanged.

findings.title: scripts/audit/run_embedded_audit.py [4]
findings.body:
The type guard is applied only in the NOT_REQUIRED branch. If a caller supplies a non-int, non-None `expected_pr` (e.g. "" or a dict) together with a proof that does not claim NOT_REQUIRED, `not not_required_claimed` is True, the guard short-circuits, and `int(expected_pr)` raises an uncaught ValueError/TypeError out of a fail-closed validator. All in-repo callers pass an int or None (argparse `type=int` in src/dopemux_pr_steward/cli.py and tools/pr_steward/intake; `int(os.environ[...])` in both workflows; `pr.pr_id` in queue_drain), so the path is not reachable today.
Auditor disposition: ROBUSTNESS_ONLY, NON-BLOCKING. Recommend hoisting the identity type validation above the branch so malformed caller identity is always an error string rather than an exception.

findings.title: tests/dopemux_cli/test_pr_steward_cmd.py [5]
findings.body:
A fail-closed assertion (rc==2 plus a TP-DMX-STEWARD-DOCTOR-303 stderr marker) is replaced by a PASS-only assertion (rc==0, status PASS, config_schema PASS, scaffold_skew PASS, empty stderr) against the repository workspace. src/dopemux_pr_steward/cli.py `_run_doctor` does delegate to the implemented `run_doctor` and returns 0 only when `result.ok`, so the old expectation was genuinely stale. However, `src/dopemux_pr_steward/doctor.py` and `tests/dopemux_cli/test_doctor.py` are not part of the supplied subject, so the compensating fail-closed coverage asserted by B0_BASELINE_REPAIR.json ('existing positive and fail-closed doctor tests', 5 passed) cannot be confirmed from the audited bytes.
Auditor disposition: ACCEPTED_WITH_LIMITATION. `doctor` is report-only and holds no merge/finalization authority (no gate consumes it), so the security impact is negligible; recorded as unverified compensating coverage.

findings.title: tests/pr_merge_specialist/test_queue_drain_integration.py [6]
findings.body:
The finalization gate is evaluated with `now=None`, i.e. the real clock (`_is_stale` falls back to `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`). With a fixed generated_at of 2026-05-31T12:00:00Z and a 10,000,000-second TTL (~115.7 days), the fixture expires deterministically and the test will begin failing without any code change. Pre-existing: the diff changes only two `repo=` keyword values in this test.
Auditor disposition: PRE_EXISTING_TEST_TIME_DEPENDENCE, NON-BLOCKING. Recommend pinning `now` or deriving generated_at from the clock, as the sibling test test_live_queue_finalization_uses_client_repo_and_exact_pr_state already does.

findings.title: src/dopemux_pr_merge_specialist/steward_gate.py [7]
findings.body:
The caller base SHA is bound only to the proof's nested `provenance.change_contract.base_sha`. MERGE_READINESS.json carries no base field and is bound to the subject solely through `pr.head_sha` / `proof.proof_head_sha` plus TTL. A readiness artifact generated against a different base but the same head is therefore not detected by base binding.
Auditor disposition: OBSERVATION_ONLY. Consistent with the documented contract in docs/ops/steward-merge-gate.md; no action required in this packet.

findings.title: proof/TP-DMX-CI-AUDIT-EVIDENCE-GATE-001-A5-R3-PROVENANCE-CLOSURE-001/review_bundle/P2_DETERMINISTIC_SCOPE.json [8]
findings.body:
This receipt records PASS over a 22-path scope that predates the integration-fixture amendment and omits tests/pr_merge_specialist/test_queue_drain_integration.py; it carries no supersession marker. Only P2_INTEGRATION_ALIGNMENT.json and P2_FINAL_VALIDATION.json reflect the final 23-path scope, and PROOF.json points to those two as the authoritative receipts.
Auditor disposition: PRESERVED_HISTORY_ACCEPTED. Layering is consistent with the packet's preserve-historical-receipts invariant; noted so a future reader does not mistake the earlier scope for the final one.

findings.title: proof/TP-DMX-CI-AUDIT-EVIDENCE-GATE-001-A5-R3-PROVENANCE-CLOSURE-001/review_bundle/FINAL_SUBSTANTIVE_DIFF.patch [9]
findings.body:
The comparison patch is itself part of the frozen tree but necessarily absent from the diff it contains (the diff shows 43 changed paths; the 44th supplied file is the patch). The supplied 13562c8d->head diff is therefore not a complete description of the frozen tree.
Auditor disposition: EXPECTED_SELF_REFERENCE. Mitigated because full file contents were supplied for all 44 files and were audited directly rather than only through the diff.
